label_method: Manual transcription of original vector PDF physical page 2, with a complete page render followed by enlarged target-table render. No backend extractor/parser/evaluator, prediction, or provider/model call. Independent source-only cross-QA still required before scoring. Independent source-only QA by /root/evaluation_resume inspected the original complete PDF page and full target table before opening the draft key. All 33 numeric facts and 16 positions agreed. Canonical field-name correction only: pole_count -> poles in 11 fact keys and mirrored/inventory representations; no numeric value, row class, or source identity changed. No predictions or parser/provider/evaluator outputs inspected. Final scope/authority contract applied before any prediction, at coordinator request: 11 independently checked pole observations moved outside numeric scoring; frame/trip values and all 16 position classes remain unchanged. Reference authority is historical_reference_only to require extraction-only execution.

scope.requirements: 22 explicit numeric overcurrent facts (frame_a and trip_a) on 11 scheduled equipped/spare circuit rows. Trip is not continuous/rated current. No per-breaker interrupting value asserted from panel-header AIC. Eleven independently reviewed equipped/spare pole observations are outside the requested frame/current/interrupting scoring scope and remain unscored.
scope.device_inventory: All 16 literal circuit positions of one bounded panel schedule. Five Space + Bus rows retain blank frame/trip as unknown and have no asserted installed breaker ratings.
scope.identity: Original circuit numerals preserved in source_identifier, qualified by literal table identifier in metadata. Compound answer-key IDs are table/row coordinates, never invented device tags.
scope.other_tables_on_selected_page: Unscored. Repeated circuit numerals elsewhere on the same page create strict current scorer identity ambiguity; expected ratings must never choose an identity. Any ambiguous result remains ambiguous.
scope.unscored_empty_preparation_poles: All printed pole/preparation capacity observations are unscored; prepared-space pole capacity is not an installed breaker count.
